main.description: Looks up one indexed activity by full AT-URI. Authentication is not required.

uri.description: Full AT-URI of the activity, using a DID authority.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is invalid or the request includes an unsupported parameter.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed activity exists at the requested URI.

errors.name: ActivityQueryFailed
errors.description: The activity lookup or required hydration failed.

activityView.description: Activity record with its original payload, hydrated author, and contributors only when present in the source record.

contributors.description: Hydrated projection of object entries in record.contributors, preserving their relative order and multiplicity; legacy string entries are skipped and the original record remains unchanged. Omitted only when the source field is absent; if it contains no object entries, this is an empty array.

activityContributorView.description: Source contributor fields with nullable hydrated projections; unavailable referenced information or unresolved identities are null, while lookup failures fail the query.

contributorInformationView.description: Contributor-information record matched by the source reference's URI and CID; newer versions are not substituted.

contributorActorView.description: Contributor DID with its current profile, if indexed.
